description: cfd_3d_net_wall (fixed wall net X 320 3, inflow and outflow) with two refined levels around the net (G 1 2, G 15, G 7 0) on 5 ranks in x (M 20 2: slabs of 6 cells): an edge of level 2 lies on a partition edge with the tiles across next to the inflow, which may not be refined. The level gives up its tiles at the partition edge (24 tiles not refined) instead of extending onto them; before, the extension ran slab by slab to the inflow and the run stopped with MPI_Abort -3102 (needs patch OF1/0007).
covers: reefamr3d::mark_tiles: retreat of a level at a partition edge next to an in- or outflow boundary
